judgments.reason: The immunohistochemistry panel shows CD10− and MUM-1+, which are the key markers defining the activated B-cell (ABC) subtype by the Hans classifier (non-GCB/ABC profile). These markers are literally present in the vignette and clinically support the ABC subtype classification.

While CD30+ is literally present in the vignette, CD30 expression alone does not specifically support the activated B-cell subtype classification of DLBCL; it is a marker seen across various lymphoma subtypes and is not part of the Hans classifier or standard ABC subtype criteria.
